The '''RD-15B Commando''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]] used by both [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] and [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] including Mandalorian soldiers during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Unlike the traditional T visors used in Mandalorian armor, the RD-15B Commando and its variant models instead used a V like visor, much like how the popular models the [[TT-17A Hydra]] and [[TT-16A Powered Assault]] armors used X visors instead of the traditional T visor.
